hindi: पति के कुल से निकल गई स्त्री पर छह पण का दण्ड है, दुर्व्यवहार को छोड़कर।
english: For a woman who has gone out from her husband's family, the penalty is six paṇas, except for ill-treatment.
notes: paṇa is a unit name and is kept. viprakāra rendered 'ill-treatment' as in the glossary (4.7).
lines_deva: पति.कुलान् निष्पतितायाः स्त्रियाः षट्.पणो दण्डः, अन्यत्र विप्रकारात्
lines_iast: pati.kulān niṣpatitāyāḥ striyāḥ ṣaṭ.paṇo daṇḍaḥ, anyatra viprakārāt

hindi: रोके जाने पर बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: [In the case of a woman] who has been forbidden, [the penalty is] twelve paṇas.
notes: Elliptical: the word for 'penalty' and the thing forbidden (going out) are not stated; only the feminine locative shows a woman is meant.

words.gloss: who has gone to a neighbour's house

hindi: पड़ोसी के घर गई हुई के लिए छह पण का दण्ड है।
english: For [a woman] who has gone to a neighbour's house, [the penalty is] six paṇas.

hindi: पड़ोसियों, भिक्षुकों और वैदेहकों को स्थान, भिक्षा, पण्य देने पर बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: For giving room, alms and wares to neighbours, mendicants and traders, the penalty is twelve paṇas.
notes: The giver is not stated (the woman of the preceding units is understood). vaidehaka: glossary gives 'trader'; Hindi kept as वैदेहक (8.4) since 12.2 also has व्यापारी. paṇya = wares.

hindi: जो रोके गए हैं उनके लिए प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है।
english: For the forbidden [ones], [the penalty is] the first fine for rashness.
notes: pratiṣiddhānām (gen. pl.) may refer to the recipients (neighbours etc.) forbidden to be given, or to the things forbidden; the text does not say. pūrva 'first' as the first of the grades of sāhasa-daṇḍa is not stated here.

words.gloss: who has gone to another's house

hindi: दूसरे के घर गई हुई के लिए चौबीस पण का दण्ड है।
english: For [a woman] who has gone to another's house, [the penalty is] twenty-four paṇas.

words.gloss: in giving room to another's wife

hindi: दूसरे की पत्नी को स्थान देने पर सौ का दण्ड है, आपत्तियों को छोड़कर।
english: For giving room to another's wife, [there is] a penalty of a hundred, except in adversities.
notes: Unit of the hundred is not stated and none is added. The giver is not stated. The src token 'anyatra-āpadbhyaḥ' is a '-' join of two words.

hindi: निवारण और अज्ञान में निर्दोष है।
english: In [cases of] prevention and ignorance, [the person is] blameless.
notes: vāraṇa (prevention, being held back) and ajñāna (ignorance) as printed. The intended sense may be 'when there was no prohibition and no knowledge' (a-vāraṇa) or 'when prevented (by force) or unaware'; not decided, nothing changed in the text. Subject not stated. Reviewer: vāraṇa-ajñānayoḥ is a regular dual locative of a dvandva as printed; no typo found, so no text_flag. nirdoṣaḥ is masculine, so the subject is not necessarily the woman.

words.gloss: of the families of: husband's kin, one in comfortable circumstances, village headman, anvādhi, woman mendicant, kin

hindi: “पति के दुर्व्यवहार के कारण पति के सम्बन्धियों, सुख की अवस्था वाले, ग्रामिक, अन्वाधि, भिक्षुकी और सम्बन्धियों के कुलों में से किसी एक में, जिसमें पुरुष न हो, जाना निर्दोष है,” ऐसा आचार्य कहते हैं।
english: “On account of the husband's ill-treatment, it is without fault to go to any one, [which is] without a man, of the families of the husband's kin, one in comfortable circumstances, a village headman, anvādhi, a woman mendicant, [and] kin,” say the teachers.
notes: The long dvandva is hard to divide: pati-jñāti may be 'husband's kin' or 'husband, kin'; the final -kula may belong to every member or only to the last jñāti. anvādhi is obscure and kept untranslated. grāmika rendered 'village headman' (medium). apuruṣam is neuter and agrees with anyatamam (a household without a man); compare unit 10 'sa-puruṣaṃ jñāti-kulam'. The closing iti is carried by the quotation marks.
lines_deva: "पति.विप्रकारात् पति.ज्ञाति.सुख.अवस्थ.ग्रामिक.अन्वाधि.भिक्षुकी.ज्ञाति.कुलानाम् अन्यतमम् अपुरुषं गन्तुम् अदोषः" इति आचार्याः
lines_iast: "pati.viprakārāt pati.jñāti.sukha.avastha.grāmika.anvādhi.bhikṣukī.jñāti.kulānām anyatamam apuruṣaṃ gantum adoṣaḥ" iti ācāryāḥ

hindi: अथवा पुरुष सहित सम्बन्धियों का कुल।
english: Or the family of kin, with a man [in it].
notes: Continues the construction of unit 9 ('to go to'); speaker not marked (apparently a second view).

hindi: भला साध्वी स्त्रियों का छल कहाँ से हो?
english: Whence, indeed, [could there be] deceit of virtuous women?
notes: chala can also mean 'pretext'; the speaker (an objector, or the teachers) is not marked. The src token 'sādhvī.janasyac-chalam' is the regular cch sandhi of janasya + chalam, written with a '-' join, so it has two word entries.

hindi: “यह समझना सरल है,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं।
english: “This is easy to understand,” says Kautilya.
notes: 'this' (etat) is not specified; it may point back to the preceding question about deceit. No quotation marks in the source; the glossary formula 'iti X' is followed.

words.gloss: for the sake of the deceased, disease, calamity, pregnancy
going to the family of kin

hindi: मृतक, रोग, व्यसन, गर्भ के निमित्त सम्बन्धियों के कुल में जाना निषिद्ध है ही नहीं।
english: Going to the family of kin is indeed not forbidden for the sake of the deceased, disease, calamity or pregnancy.
notes: preta = the deceased (glossary); whether it means a death in the family is not stated. vyasana rendered 'calamity'; garbha literally 'womb, embryo', rendered 'pregnancy'.

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. caus. √vṛ

hindi: उस निमित्त से रोकने वाले पर बारह पण का दण्ड है।
english: For one who prevents [it] on that account, the penalty is twelve paṇas.
notes: Object of vārayataḥ not stated. The printed 'tan.nimittaṃ' is regular sandhi of tat + nimittam.

words.gram: f. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √guh
m. nom. pl. pres. part. caus. √chad

hindi: वहाँ भी छिपाती हुई स्त्रीधन से वंचित की जाए, अथवा छिपाते हुए सम्बन्धी शुल्क के शेष से वंचित किए जाएँ। यह निकल जाना है।
english: Even there, [a woman] concealing [it] would be deprived of [her] woman's property, or the kinsmen, concealing [it], [would be deprived of] the remainder of the śulka. Such is the going out (niṣpatana).
notes: The verb jīyeta (passive of √jyā 'deprive', with the object kept in the accusative) is singular and goes with the woman; for the kinsmen it is understood. It is not certain what is concealed or who loses what; the second clause could also mean the kinsmen conceal the remaining śulka. śulka read as bride-price (glossary 4.12). '| 15 |' is the edition's verse number inside the text; 'iti niṣpatanam' closes the section, rendered 'Such is ...' (closing particle). Reviewer: śulka elsewhere means toll/duty; the translation keeps śulka untranslated and the bride-price reading (as 4.12) rests on context only, not verified.
lines_deva: तत्र-अपि गूहमाना स्त्री.धनं जीयेत, ज्ञातयो वा छादयन्तः शुल्क.शेषम् । १५ । इति निष्पतनम्
lines_iast: tatra-api gūhamānā strī.dhanaṃ jīyeta, jñātayo vā chādayantaḥ śulka.śeṣam | 15 | iti niṣpatanam

hindi: पति के कुल से निकलकर दूसरे गाँव में जाने पर बारह पण का दण्ड है और स्थाप्य आभरणों की हानि है।
english: Having gone out from the husband's family, on going to another village, the penalty is twelve paṇas and the loss of the sthāpya ornaments.
notes: sthāpya (gerundive of √sthā, literally 'to be placed') is a technical qualifier of the ornaments; its exact sense is not stated here and is kept untranslated.
lines_deva: पति.कुलान् निष्पत्य ग्राम.अन्तर.गमने द्वादश.पणो दण्डः स्थाप्या.आभरण.लोपश् च
lines_iast: pati.kulān niṣpatya grāma.antara.gamane dvādaśa.paṇo daṇḍaḥ sthāpyā.ābharaṇa.lopaś ca

words.gloss: giving of maintenance and going to a tīrtha

hindi: अथवा गम्य पुरुष के साथ प्रस्थान करने पर चौबीस पण का दण्ड और समस्त धर्म की हानि है, भरण-पोषण देने और तीर्थ जाने को छोड़कर।
english: Or, on setting out with an approachable man, [the penalty is] twenty-four paṇas and the loss of all dharma, except for giving maintenance and going to a tīrtha.
notes: gamya (literally 'to be gone to') is kept literal; what makes a man gamya is not stated. bharma = maintenance, wages (literal); tīrtha literally 'ford, holy place', and in units 31-37 counted in numbers, where its sense is not settled; here taken as the place. 'loss of all dharma' may mean loss of all legal claims; not decided.
lines_deva: गम्येन वा पुंसा सह प्रस्थाने चतुर्.विंशति.पणः सर्व.धर्म.लोपश् च, अन्यत्र भर्म.दान.तीर्थ.गमनाभ्याम्
lines_iast: gamyena vā puṃsā saha prasthāne catur.viṃśati.paṇaḥ sarva.dharma.lopaś ca, anyatra bharma.dāna.tīrtha.gamanābhyām

words.gloss: of the equal and the better

hindi: पुरुष के लिए तुल्य और श्रेष्ठ के विषय में प्रथम साहस-दण्ड है; निकृष्ट के लिए मध्यम।
english: For the man, [the penalty is] the first fine for rashness [in the case] of the equal and the better; for the worse, the middle.
notes: Equal, better and worse are not related to anything in the unit (rank of the man compared with the woman, or the other way round, is not stated). 'the middle' is bare (glossary: nothing supplied).
lines_deva: पुंसः पूर्वः साहस.दण्डः तुल्य.श्रेयसोः, पापीयसो मध्यमः
lines_iast: puṃsaḥ pūrvaḥ sāhasa.daṇḍaḥ tulya.śreyasoḥ, pāpīyaso madhyamaḥ

hindi: बन्धु दण्ड के अयोग्य है।
english: A relative is not to be punished.

hindi: निषेध होने पर आधे दण्ड हैं।
english: In [the case of] prohibition, [there are] half-penalties.
notes: Whose prohibition (the woman's refusal or a prohibition by others) and which penalties are halved is not stated; the plural may mean half of each of the penalties above.

words.gloss: in going to a hidden place
for the purpose of sexual union

hindi: मार्ग में, अन्तर में, छिपे स्थान पर जाने में, मैथुन के प्रयोजन से, अथवा शंकित और निषिद्ध के पीछे मार्ग में चलने में, संग्रहण जानना चाहिए।
english: On the road, in an interval, in going to a hidden place, for the purpose of sexual union, or in following on the road [a woman] who is suspected [and] forbidden, one should know [it to be] saṅgrahaṇa (literally 'seizing').
notes: vyantare (vi-antara) is obscure: literally 'in an interval, in between'; 'in a remote place' is possible but not stated. The feminine locative śaṅkita-pratiṣiddhāyām implies a woman; the object of following is not stated. saṅgrahaṇa is a technical term kept with its literal sense. Reviewer: the dvandva is read literally 'suspected and forbidden'; 'suspected or forbidden' is possible but is not in the compound.
lines_deva: पथि व्यन्तरे गूढ.देश.अभिगमने मैथुन.अर्थेन शङ्कित.प्रतिषिद्धायां वा पथ्य्.अनुसरणे सङ्ग्रहणं विद्यात्
lines_iast: pathi vyantare gūḍha.deśa.abhigamane maithuna.arthena śaṅkita.pratiṣiddhāyāṃ vā pathy.anusaraṇe saṅgrahaṇaṃ vidyāt

words.gloss: of tāla-avacaras, cāraṇas, fishermen, hunters, cowherds, liquor-sellers

hindi: ताल-अवचर, चारण, मछली पकड़ने वाले, शिकारी, ग्वाले, मद्य बेचने वाले और जिनकी स्त्रियाँ छोड़ी हुई हैं ऐसे दूसरों के लिए मार्ग में पीछे चलना निर्दोष है।
english: For tāla-avacaras, cāraṇas, fishermen, hunters, cowherds, liquor-sellers and others whose women are set free, following on the road is without fault.
notes: tāla-avacara is obscure (tāla 'palm' or 'beat', avacara 'frequenter'), kept untranslated; cāraṇa kept as a term (glossary 4.1). It is not stated whose women are followed or whether the following concerns their own women.

hindi: अथवा निषिद्ध होने पर ले जाते हुए पुरुष के लिए या जाती हुई स्त्री के लिए वे ही आधे दण्ड हैं। यह मार्ग में पीछे चलना है।
english: Or, when [it is] forbidden, for a man who leads [her] or for a woman who goes, [there are] just those half-penalties. Such is the following on the road.
notes: 'ta eva' in src is regular sandhi of te eva. 'Those half-penalties' points back to unit 20. Object of nayataḥ not stated. '| 23 |' is the edition's verse number; 'iti ...' closes the section. The src token 'eva-ardha.daṇḍāḥ' is a '-' join of two words.
lines_deva: प्रतिषिद्धे वा नयतः पुंसः स्त्रियो वा गच्छन्त्यास् त एव-अर्ध.दण्डाः । २३ । इति पथ्य्.अनुसरणम्
lines_iast: pratiṣiddhe vā nayataḥ puṃsaḥ striyo vā gacchantyās ta eva-ardha.daṇḍāḥ | 23 | iti pathy.anusaraṇam

words.gloss: of those away for a short time

hindi: थोड़े समय के प्रवासी शूद्रों, वैश्यों, क्षत्रियों और ब्राह्मणों की पत्नियाँ, जिन्होंने सन्तान नहीं जनी, एक वर्ष आगे का समय प्रतीक्षा करें; जिन्होंने सन्तान जनी, एक वर्ष से अधिक।
english: The wives of śūdras, vaiśyas, kṣatriyas and brāhmaṇas who are away for a short time should await a time that is a year further, if they have not borne children; [a time] exceeding a year, if they have borne children.
notes: saṃvatsara-uttara is unclear: 'a year further/beyond', or a period rising by a year for each varṇa in the order listed; the text does not say, and nothing is supplied. ākāṅkṣ literally 'desire, expect'; rendered 'await'.
lines_deva: ह्रस्व.प्रवासिनां शूद्र.वैश्य.क्षत्रिय.ब्राह्मणानां भार्याः संवत्सर.उत्तरं कालम् आकाङ्क्षेरन् अप्रजाताः, संवत्सर.अधिकं प्रजाताः
lines_iast: hrasva.pravāsināṃ śūdra.vaiśya.kṣatriya.brāhmaṇānāṃ bhāryāḥ saṃvatsara.uttaraṃ kālam ākāṅkṣeran aprajātāḥ, saṃvatsara.adhikaṃ prajātāḥ

hindi: व्यवस्था की गई दुगुना समय प्रतीक्षा करे।
english: [A woman] who has been provided for [should await] twice the period.
notes: Singular feminine used generically; what she was provided with is not stated; the verb is understood from unit 24.

hindi: जिनकी व्यवस्था नहीं की गई उनका भरण सुख की अवस्था वाले करें; अधिक से अधिक चार वर्ष या आठ, सम्बन्धी।
english: Those in comfortable circumstances should maintain those who have not been provided for; at most four years or eight, the kinsmen.
notes: The src 'sukha.avasthā' is sukha-avasthāḥ with the visarga dropped before b. Unclear whether sukha-avasthāḥ and jñātayaḥ are the same persons, and whether 'four or eight' go with childless / with-child as in unit 24; param may also mean 'beyond'. Read literally.
lines_deva: अप्रतिविहिताः सुख.अवस्था बिभृयुः, परं चत्वारि वर्षाण्य् अष्टौ वा ज्ञातयः
lines_iast: aprativihitāḥ sukha.avasthā bibhṛyuḥ, paraṃ catvāri varṣāṇy aṣṭau vā jñātayaḥ

hindi: तब जैसा दिया गया था वैसा लेकर छोड़ दें।
english: Then, having taken [it] as given, they should release [her].
notes: Object of ādāya (what was given) and of pramuñceyuḥ (the woman) not stated; 'taken back what was given' is the likely sense.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. mid. adhi-√i

words.gloss: woman who has not borne children

hindi: सन्तान न जनी हुई अध्ययन करते हुए ब्राह्मण की दस वर्ष, सन्तान जनी हुई बारह वर्ष प्रतीक्षा करे; राजपुरुष की प्रतीक्षा आयु के क्षय तक करे।
english: [A woman] who has not borne children should, for ten years, await a brāhmaṇa who is studying; [one] who has borne children, for twelve [years]; [she should await] a royal servant until the end of [his] life.
notes: 'years' with dvādaśa and 'his' with life are supplied. The verb takes the accusative of the person awaited.
lines_deva: ब्राह्मणम् अधीयानं दश.वर्षाण्य् अप्रजाता, द्वादश प्रजाता, राज.पुरुषम् आयुः.क्षयाद् आकाङ्क्षेत
lines_iast: brāhmaṇam adhīyānaṃ daśa.varṣāṇy aprajātā, dvādaśa prajātā, rāja.puruṣam āyuḥ.kṣayād ākāṅkṣeta

words.gloss: from one of the same varṇa

hindi: और समान वर्ण वाले से सन्तान जनी हुई निन्दा न पाए।
english: And [a woman] who has borne a child by [a man] of the same varṇa would not incur blame.
notes: The src token 'na-apavādaṃ' is a '-' join of two words. 'by a man' is supplied in brackets.

words.gloss: on loss of the household's prosperity

hindi: अथवा कुटुम्ब की समृद्धि का लोप होने पर सुख की अवस्था वालों से छोड़ी गई इच्छानुसार प्राप्त करे, या जीवन के लिए आपत्ति में पड़ी हुई।
english: Or, on the loss of the household's prosperity, [a woman] released by those in comfortable circumstances should find as desired; or one who has fallen into adversity for the sake of life.
notes: The object of vindeta (what she finds; √vid can also mean 'marry') is not stated. The last clause is elliptical (no verb); jīvita-artham may go with āpad-gatā or with the sense 'for livelihood'. Read literally.
lines_deva: कुटुम्ब.ऋद्धि.लोपे वा सुख.अवस्थैर् विमुक्ता यथा.इष्टं विन्देत, जीवित.अर्थम् आपद्.गता वा
lines_iast: kuṭumba.ṛddhi.lope vā sukha.avasthair vimuktā yathā.iṣṭaṃ vindeta, jīvita.artham āpad.gatā vā

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. pass. √śru
m. acc. sg. pres. part. pass. √śru

hindi: धर्म-विवाह के बाद कुमारी, बिना बताए प्रवास पर गए, सुने न जाते हुए पति की सात तीर्थ प्रतीक्षा करे; सुने जाते हुए की एक वर्ष।
english: After a dharma marriage, a maiden should await for seven tīrthas the husband who has gone away without telling [her], not being heard of; [one who is] heard of, for a year.
notes: tīrtha literally 'ford, holy place'; counted in numbers here, so some recurring period is probably meant; kept untranslated (sense not settled). parigrahītṛ literally 'taker', rendered 'husband'. 'after' for the ablative dharma-vivāhāt is the natural sense.
lines_deva: धर्म.विवाहात् कुमारी परिग्रहीतारम् अनाख्याय प्रोषितम् अश्रूयमाणं सप्त तीर्थान्य् आकाङ्क्षेत, संवत्सरं श्रूयमाणम्
lines_iast: dharma.vivāhāt kumārī parigrahītāram anākhyāya proṣitam aśrūyamāṇaṃ sapta tīrthāny ākāṅkṣeta, saṃvatsaraṃ śrūyamāṇam

hindi: बताकर प्रवास पर गए, सुने न जाते हुए की पाँच तीर्थ प्रतीक्षा करे; सुने जाते हुए की दस।
english: [She] should await for five tīrthas one who has gone away after telling [her], not being heard of; [one who is] heard of, for ten.
notes: Subject (the maiden of unit 31) and 'tīrtha' as in unit 31.
lines_deva: आख्याय प्रोषितम् अश्रूयमाणं पञ्च तीर्थान्य् आकाङ्क्षेत, दश श्रूयमाणम्
lines_iast: ākhyāya proṣitam aśrūyamāṇaṃ pañca tīrthāny ākāṅkṣeta, daśa śrūyamāṇam

hindi: जिसने शुल्क एक भाग में दिया है, सुने न जाते हुए ऐसे की तीन तीर्थ प्रतीक्षा करे; सुने जाते हुए की सात तीर्थ।
english: [She] should await for three tīrthas [one] by whom the śulka was given in one part and who is not heard of; [one who is] heard of, for seven tīrthas.
notes: eka-deśa could also be 'in one place'; read 'in one part' (partly paid). śulka as bride-price (glossary 4.12). The src token 'aśrūyamāṇam,' carries a comma.
lines_deva: एक.देश.दत्त.शुल्कं त्रीणि तीर्थान्य् अश्रूयमाणम्, श्रूयमाणं सप्त तीर्थान्य् आकाङ्क्षेत
lines_iast: eka.deśa.datta.śulkaṃ trīṇi tīrthāny aśrūyamāṇam, śrūyamāṇaṃ sapta tīrthāny ākāṅkṣeta

hindi: जिसने शुल्क दिया है, सुने न जाते हुए ऐसे की पाँच तीर्थ प्रतीक्षा करे; सुने जाते हुए की दस।
english: [She should await for] five tīrthas [one] who has given the śulka and is not heard of; [one who is] heard of, for ten.
notes: The verb ākāṅkṣeta is understood from unit 33; tīrtha as above.
lines_deva: दत्त.शुल्कं पञ्च तीर्थान्य् अश्रूयमाणम्, दश श्रूयमाणम्
lines_iast: datta.śulkaṃ pañca tīrthāny aśrūyamāṇam, daśa śrūyamāṇam

hindi: उसके बाद धर्मस्थों द्वारा छोड़ी गई इच्छानुसार प्राप्त करे।
english: After that, released by the dharmasthas, she should find as desired.
notes: Object of vindeta not stated (see unit 30). dharmastha kept as a title.
lines_deva: ततः परं धर्मस्थैर् विसृष्टा यथा.इष्टं विन्देत
lines_iast: tataḥ paraṃ dharmasthair visṛṣṭā yathā.iṣṭaṃ vindeta

hindi: “तीर्थ का अवरोध निश्चय ही धर्म का वध है,” ऐसा कौटिल्य कहते हैं। यह थोड़े समय का प्रवास है।
english: “Obstruction of the tīrtha is indeed destruction of dharma,” says Kautilya. Such is the short absence.
notes: 'dharma.vadha iti' in src is dharma-vadhaḥ iti with the visarga dropped. vadha literally 'killing, destruction'. '| 36 |' is the edition's verse number; the last 'iti ...' closes the section. tīrtha as in unit 31.
lines_deva: तीर्थ.उपरोधो हि धर्म.वध इति कौटिल्यः । ३६ । इति ह्रस्व.प्रवासः
lines_iast: tīrtha.uparodho hi dharma.vadha iti kauṭilyaḥ | 36 | iti hrasva.pravāsaḥ

words.gloss: of one away for a long time

hindi: दीर्घ प्रवास वाले, प्रव्रजित अथवा मृतक की पत्नी सात तीर्थ प्रतीक्षा करे; जिसने सन्तान जनी हो, एक वर्ष।
english: The wife of one who is away for a long time, or who has gone forth, or of the deceased, should await seven tīrthas; [if] she has borne a child, a year.
notes: pravrajita (gone forth) is the one who has left household life; kept as 'gone forth'. 'if' is supplied in brackets for prajātā.
lines_deva: दीर्घ.प्रवासिनः प्रव्रजितस्य प्रेतस्य वा भार्या सप्त तीर्थान्य् आकाङ्क्षेत, संवत्सरं प्रजाता
lines_iast: dīrgha.pravāsinaḥ pravrajitasya pretasya vā bhāryā sapta tīrthāny ākāṅkṣeta, saṃvatsaraṃ prajātā

hindi: तब पति के सहोदर के पास जाए।
english: Then she should go to the husband's uterine brother.
notes: sodarya literally 'of the same womb'; 'uterine brother' is the plain rendering.

hindi: बहुतों में निकटतम, धर्मनिष्ठ, भरण-पोषण में समर्थ, सबसे छोटे अथवा पत्नी-रहित के पास।
english: Among many, [to] the nearest, righteous [one], able to maintain, [to] the youngest, or one without a wife.
notes: Continues unit 38; 'go to' is understood. Whether 'many' are brothers is not stated. Whether 'nearest, righteous, able' are alternatives or cumulative is not marked.
lines_deva: बहुषु प्रत्यासन्नं धार्मिकं भर्म.समर्थं कनिष्ठम् अभार्यं वा
lines_iast: bahuṣu pratyāsannaṃ dhārmikaṃ bharma.samarthaṃ kaniṣṭham abhāryaṃ vā

hindi: उसके अभाव में भी सहोदर से भिन्न, सपिण्ड अथवा निकट के कुल्य के पास जाए।
english: Even in the absence of that [person], [she should go to] one not of the same womb, a sapiṇḍa, or a kinsman (kulya) who is near.
notes: 'asodaryam sapiṇḍam' may be one phrase (a sapiṇḍa not of the same womb) or two items; āsannam may go with kulya only or with all. 'go to' understood. The src token 'vā-āsannam' is a '-' join of two words.
lines_deva: तद्.अभावे ऽप्य् असोदर्यं सपिण्डं कुल्यं वा-आसन्नम्

hindi: इनका यही क्रम है।
english: Of these, this alone is the order.

words.gloss: in the act of a paramour

hindi: इन दायादों को लाँघकर, पाने में, जार के कर्म में, जार, स्त्री, देने वाला और पाने वाला संग्रह के अत्यय को प्राप्त हुए हैं।
english: Having passed over these heirs, in obtaining [and] in the act of a paramour, the paramour, the woman, the giver and the obtainer have incurred the penalty for saṅgraha.
notes: Verse (two lines). vedana (√vid) 'finding, obtaining'; probably marrying, but the object is not stated. dāyāda 'heir' refers back to the kinsmen of units 38-40. vettṛ 'obtainer' (the one who obtains the woman). saṅgraha (printed so) is read as the same offence-term as saṅgrahaṇa in unit 21. atyaya = penalty (glossary 5.2).
